instructions: Schedule nothing until Rej says "approve batch 2026-11-24 v4" in chat. Any other version or wording is not approval.
Call getScheduledPosts for the whole date range first. If a post with the same date, time and network is already scheduled, do not schedule it again: tell Rej.

One Metricool post per network (one provider each), using that network's caption, title and networkData exactly as given. Media, cover and altText are the post's, unless the platform has its own (Question of the day: the slides on Instagram, the reel version on TikTok and YouTube Shorts); then use the platform's.

Only platforms with status "schedule" (and check getBrandSettings networksData). "pending connection" (YouTube until it is connected) and "skipped on purpose" (Facebook: Instagram auto-shares) are not scheduled; list them for Rej.
Skip any post with doNotSchedule true.

Metricool plan: Free, 20 published posts a month in one total across networks (each network's post counts once). A post with planGate is scheduled only once Rej has said in chat that the Starter upgrade is done; until then tell Rej it is waiting on that.

AI labels: networkData sets them per post (instagramData.isAiGenerated, tiktokData.isAigc, youtubeData.isAiGeneratedContent); send them exactly as given. A post with pinAfterPosting: remind Rej to pin it once it is live.
Reels: media is the MP4 (soundtrack built in); use cover as videoThumbnailUrl. Instagram carousels stay silent; TikTok photo carousels have autoAddMusic true.
Times are UK local (Europe/London). Never change a date, time or caption without Rej asking.
After scheduling, confirm in chat with the Metricool ids. Claude Code logs them at the start of its next session (no email).

posts.pinAfterPosting: Pin this post to the top of the Instagram and TikTok profiles once it is live (by hand in each app: Metricool cannot pin).
altText: Reel on a navy background. Three small circles, green, orange and pink, quickly merge into a glowing sphere of dots under the heading Meet Em. The sphere turns pink and pulses as Em speaks, with each word lighting up in the caption. Hi, I'm Em, your revision helper. Ask me anything you're revising, with a small card of a student's question bubble and Em typing a reply. Write an answer, and I'll mark it point by point, with a card of three marking points, two ticked and one crossed with how to get it, and 2 of 3 marks. I'll plan your revision around your exam dates, with a card of a two-week calendar with coloured revision dots and an exam day. All built on your exam board's spec. Ends on text: Launching 11 January on iPhone, Android and the web. Join early access, link in bio. Em is AI and can make mistakes.
